archetype: Archetype 2 (Performance Pro) mixed with Archetype 5 (Luxury) for a premium Apple-level design

visual_enhancers.shadows: None. Rely on 1px subtle borders (Linear style) to define surfaces instead of dropshadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for sticky navigation or AI chat overlays: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/70 border-t border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Minimal. Use subtle radial gradients at the top of the screen (from rgba(10,132,255,0.15) to transparent) for premium feel on key screens like Subscription or AI Insights.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: Mobile-first responsive app layout. If building for web, use max-w-md mx-auto to simulate a native app frame or strict centered command-center dashboard.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use gap-6 or gap-8 between major sections. Inner padding of cards should be p-5 or p-6.
grids_and_layouts.border_radius: rounded-2xl for major cards (Apple style), rounded-full for primary action buttons, rounded-xl for inputs.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A84FF] text-white rounded-full font-medium py-3 px-6 hover:bg-[#0070E0] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 text-white rounded-full font-medium py-3 px-6 hover:bg-white/10 active:scale-[0.98] border border-white/10

components.inputs: bg-[#1C1C1C] border border-transparent focus:border-[#0A84FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0A84FF] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder-zinc-500
components.ai_chat: Conversational UI mimicking high-end chat. User messages: bg-white/10 rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm. AI messages: bg-transparent border border-white/10 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm. AI avatar should have a subtle electric blue glow.
components.workout_logger: Large touch targets. One-tap '+' buttons for logging sets. Display previous weight suggestions automatically.

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions on all taps: scale-95 duration-100 ease-in-out.
motion.page_transitions: Smooth fade in and upward slide (translate-y-4 to 0) using framer-motion.
motion.ai_typing: Subtle pulsing opacity animation for AI typing indicators.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text meets 4.5:1 ratio against #141414. Use #A1A1AA for secondary text, which passes AA on pure black.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have clear focus-visible rings using the brand primary color.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

media.icons: lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5. Clean and minimal.

image_urls.description: Dark electric blue abstract texture for the Subscription paywall or AI Coach intro screen background.
Premium dark gym atmosphere, focused weight training for workout plan headers.
Premium dark gym atmosphere, female athlete for workout plan headers.
Moody, cinematic barbell shot for empty states or goal setting screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark-first UI palette (Background: #0A0A0A, Surfaces: #141414, Accent: #0A84FF).
Use Manrope for headings to impart a premium Apple-like feel, and Inter for body text.
DO NOT use generic Shadcn cards without stripping out heavy shadows and thick borders. Use bg-[#141414] and border-white/5 for a clean 'Linear' style.
Every actionable item (button, tab, input, workout log) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute for testing.
Make the 'Home Dashboard' a clear, uncluttered command center. Prioritize 'Today's Workout' and the 'AI Coach Message'.
For the 'Workout Execution Screen', ensure UI components have large, one-tap hit areas. It must feel effortless to log sets while training.
Implement the 'Subscription Paywall' screen with the 'premium_background' image behind an overlay to sell the luxury aspect.
Never use placeholder image URLs. Rely on the provided image_urls for all visual needs.
Keep body text left-aligned for clear functional reading, and avoid center-aligning unless it's a specific hero title or empty state.
